summary: Re-tested Cloudflare fix + two-phase Save/Share UX on StreamClip AI. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed via external URL. Verified e2e-real download job -> file endpoint returns HTTP 200, content-type video/mp4, Content-Length header EQUALS body byte length exactly, and ffprobe reports 1080x1920. Demo POST /api/clips/{demo}/download-jobs -> 400 friendly, GET /api/download-jobs/unknown -> 404. Regression on seed / channels / clips / generate all pass. Frontend: two-phase flow works: clicking outline download button on E2E->Real Clip Test shows spinner + disabled, then ~30s later transforms into a GREEN 'Save / Share' button (bg-[#00E676], animate-pulse). Clicking Save/Share in headless (navigator.canShare({files}) === false) falls back to direct browser download of 'e2etest_9x16.mp4' (verified via Playwright download event). Demo clip download click shows sonner info toast 'Sample clip — add your own channel and hit Get clips for real videos' and does NOT navigate or trigger a download.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_download_job_file now returns Response(content=bytes, media_type='video/mp4') with explicit Content-Length — good; matches Cloudflare requirement. Consider streaming for very large files, but current rendered clips are small (<2MB) so buffering is fine.

ClipCard.jsx: phase state machine (idle|rendering|ready) is clean; fileRef holds the rendered File object across the tap gesture so navigator.share fires inside the user activation window as required by browsers.
Minor: emits a console warning for the e2e clip which has empty thumbnail_url — not blocking, but consider a placeholder image when thumbnail_url is empty.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/demo/seed invoked at end to leave 3 demo channels + 18 clips. e2e / e2e-real preserved (were already seeded).
context_for_next_testing_agent: e2e channel (id=e2e, login=e2etest) + e2e-real clip (slug GleamingWildCougarFUNgineer) persisted in Mongo test_database. Backend file endpoint returns non-streamed Response with Content-Length header — new assertion added to test_download_e2e_real_job_flow verifying header int equals len(body). Frontend uses navigator.share with files fallback to <a download>.
